text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa declared to her former 
teacher that she would star in the Classic 
Triple Crown and become a runner expected 
to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She would spend this entire year becoming 
someone's hope to live. And she would make 
her former homeroom teacher say it: —that 
she wanted to see her run in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, achieve a stellar result at the 
Satsuki Sho. Surely, that will lift the 
spirits of her former teacher. Because 
"hope is what keeps a person going."
